<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    const selectBox = document.querySelector('[id^="nom_etablissement"]');
    const section1 = document.getElementById('section1');
    const dataStored = document.getElementById('data_stored').value;

    function showFields(selectedValue) {
        const res = JSON.parse(dataStored);
        let found = false;

        res.forEach((r) => {
            if (r['id'] === selectedValue) {
                section1.style.display = "block";

                document.getElementById('site_web').value = r['c_site_web'] || '';
                document.getElementById('numero_fax').value = r['c_numero_fax'] || '';
                document.getElementById('numero_tel').value = r['c_numero_tel'] || '';
                document.getElementById('adresse_electronique').value = r['c_adresse_electronique'] || '';
                document.getElementById('adresse_etablissement').value = r['c_adresse_etablissement'] || '';
                document.getElementById('date_obtention_agrement').value = r['c_date_obtention_agrement'] || '';
                document.getElementById('abreviation_agrement').value = r['c_abreviation_agrement'] || '';

                setFieldsReadOnly();
                found = true;
            }
        });

        if (!found) {
            hideFields();
        }
    }

    function setFieldsReadOnly() {
        ['site_web', 'numero_fax', 'numero_tel', 'adresse_electronique', 'adresse_etablissement', 'date_obtention_agrement', 'abreviation_agrement']
            .forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).readOnly = true);
    }

    function hideFields() {
        section1.style.display = "none";
        resetFields();
    }

    function resetFields() {
        ['site_web', 'numero_fax', 'numero_tel', 'adresse_electronique', 'adresse_etablissement', 'date_obtention_agrement', 'abreviation_agrement']
            .forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).value = '');
    }

    function handleTypeChange() {
        const selectedValue = selectBox.value;
        if (selectedValue) {
            showFields(selectedValue);
        } else {
            hideFields();
        }
    }

    selectBox.addEventListener("change", handleTypeChange);

    const form = document.querySelector('form');

    form.addEventListener('submit', function() {
        const selectedValue = selectBox.value;
        if (selectedValue) {
            showFields(selectedValue);
        } else {
            hideFields();
        }
        setFieldsReadOnly();
    });

    form.addEventListener('invalid', function(e) {
        setFieldsReadOnly();
    }, true);

    // When the page loads, directly use the current selected value
    const selectedValueOnLoad = selectBox.value;
    if (selectedValueOnLoad) {
        showFields(selectedValueOnLoad);
        setFieldsReadOnly();
    } else {
        hideFields();
    }

});
</script>
